# `aitbc workflow run`

Run a workflow by name with optional configuration.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc workflow run [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--workflow-name` | text | — | yes | The Workflow name. |
| `--config` | text | — | no | Workflow configuration file |
| `--dry-run` | flag | `false` | no | Dry run without executing |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc workflow run --workflow-name <workflow_name>
```
